Refund policy

Last updated: 2026-11-14

Our products are digital downloads. If one isn't right for you, you can get your money back.

14-day refund, no questions asked

If you ask within 14 days of purchase, we will refund the full amount you paid, including any tax charged at checkout. You don't need to give a reason.

How to ask for a refund

  1. Contact us through the contact page.
  2. Include the email address you used at checkout and your order number (it's on your Polar receipt).

We aim to reply within a few business days. Once we approve a refund, it goes back to your original payment method. How long it takes to show up depends on your bank or card provider.

After a refund

When an order is refunded, its download access is switched off. Please delete any copies you downloaded. A refund ends your licence to use the product.

After 14 days

If a file is broken, won't open, or is clearly not what the product page described, contact us at any time. We will fix it, send a working file, or refund you.

Requests we may decline

We may decline requests that look like abuse of this policy, for example someone repeatedly buying and refunding the same product.

Who processes payments and refunds

Purchases are handled by Polar (polar.sh), our merchant of record. Polar is the seller in the transaction and processes payment, tax, receipts and refunds. Polar's own buyer terms, which are linked from its checkout, also apply to your purchase.

Your legal rights

This policy does not affect any rights you have under consumer law where you live.
